**About Kanpla

**Kanpla helps contract caterers create better dining experiences while cutting food waste. What started as a school project now serves more than 800,000 users across 5,000+ locations in 14 countries.

We're a team of 70+ and are growing aggressively across both Europe, UK & the US.

Our revenue comes from three places: software subscriptions, card payments on our platform, and the hardware and services we sell alongside our software. All of that runs through three legal entities (Denmark, the UK and the US) and three accounting systems. That's a lot of moving parts. So far, our VP of Finance has built and run the accounting setup, with support from our external partner ScaleUp Finance. As we grow, we want a dedicated person to take full ownership of the accounting & monthly close. That's where you come in.

**About The Role

**This is an ownership role. You'll be responsible and accountable for Kanpla's accounting function: the close, the numbers and the processes behind them.

The setup is up and running today, so you won't be starting from scratch. Our VP of Finance will onboard you and hand over the accounting, so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. From there, the function is yours to run. ScaleUp handles day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for our Danish parent company, and Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, supports you on the daily tasks.

Your job is to make sure everything going into the books is complete and correct, and that everything coming out of them is accurate and on time. Over time, we want to bring more of the work in-house and use external partners where it actually makes sense. You'll drive that, together with our VP of Finance.

You'll own finance operations end to end: what we invoice, what we collect, what we pay, what we pay our people, how we close the books and what we owe in VAT. That covers Denmark (e-conomic), the UK (Xero) and the US (QuickBooks).

We're also tidying up our structure across countries and investing heavily in automation, AI and data across the company, including a move to a new group-wide accounting / ERP system down the line. So there's plenty to build, not just to maintain.

This is a hands-on role, not a pure reporting job. You'll be accountable for making sure our numbers can be trusted, and you'll keep improving the processes behind them.

What you'll do

• Run the group close (monthly, quarterly and year-end) and lock the numbers on time, reviewing ScaleUp Finance's work along the way.

• Own AR and AP end to end: invoicing, collections, bank reconciliation and supplier payments.

• Make sure revenue matches across CRM, billing and accounting.

• Own VAT reporting across our markets, working with our external advisers.

• Manage payroll in Denmark, the UK and the US, including Employer of Record setups.

• Keep hardware margins on budget and sales in line with Incoterms and VAT, together with our Head of Hardware.

• Prepare financial statements and support budgeting and variance analysis.

• Be the main point of contact for our auditors.

• Keep improving controls and processes, and cut manual work.

What you'll bring

There's more than one route into this role. Strong candidates will probably bring most of the following:

• 4+ years in accounting or finance operations, in a growing international company or an audit or accounting firm.

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, as our parent company operates under Danish law.

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end close, ideally with an external accounting partner.

• Solid AR, AP and European VAT experience.

• Experience with e-conomic, Xero or QuickBooks, and the confidence to learn the others fast.

• Precision with reconciliations, and the habit of finding the root cause.

• The judgement to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

• Clear written English.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience from an international scale-up.

• Payroll experience, ideally across countries.

• UK or US accounting (or you'll pick it up on the job).

• ERP implementation or migration experience.

• Experience with hardware or Incoterms.

• Danish language skills.

What we offer

• Real ownership, with a direct line to the VP of Finance.

• A broad role across three countries, software, hardware, payments and payroll.

• The chance to shape our finance function, and grow with it.

• A competitive salary and real support for your development.

• Remote-first working and two off-sites or workcations a year.

Practical details

This is a full-time, permanent role, ideally based in Copenhagen, where our VP of Finance and the rest of the finance team sit. It covers our entities in Denmark, the UK and the US.

You'll report to Felix, our VP of Finance, and be part of a small finance team that also includes Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, who helps with accounts receivable, accounts payable, VAT and billing. Day to day, you'll work with Customer Success, Sales and Operations on invoicing and collections, and with our Head of Hardware on hardware. Externally, you'll work with ScaleUp, our auditors, tax advisers, payroll and Employer of Record providers, and payment partners.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to fill the role as soon as possible.

**ARE YOU READY TO DRIVE GANNI’S WHOLESALE GROWTH ACROSS SCANDINAVIA WITH PURPOSE AND PASSION?

**GANNI is looking for a Wholesale Area Manager to join our global Wholesale team!

In this role, you will play a key part — together with your fellow Area Managers — in elevating GANNI’s brand presence across the Nordics market by nurturing strategic wholesale relationships and ensuring strong commercial performance.

The area manager will take over the whole Scandinavian market to contribute to regional growth and brand elevation in close collaboration with the broader EMEA Wholesale team.

This is a dynamic mid-level role that blends commercial execution, market insight, and operational excellence — and we’re looking for someone ready to contribute and grow within an ambitious team environment.

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Wholesale Area Manager, you will support and manage wholesale partnerships across the Nordics region, working closely with other Area Managers, the Head of WS EMEA and the Executive Wholesale & Franchises Director.

Your role will focus on driving sales performance, strengthening category growth, and ensuring seamless alignment between GANNI and our wholesale partners — all in line with our global wholesale strategy.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**

• Develop and execute a comprehensive business plan aligned with the brand strategy to drive growth and strengthen GANNI’s presence across the Nordics.

• Participate in prospecting and onboarding of new wholesale partners across the Nordics.

• Strategically collaborate with wholesale partners to meet weekly, monthly, and annual trade expectations.

• Monitor sell-in and sell-out performance, taking proactive measures to maximize sell-through, reorder rates, and profitability.

• Ensure all partners and activations are aligned with GANNI brand guidelines and deliver a consistent brand experience.

• Collaborate with marketing, VM, and merchandising teams to deliver local marketing initiatives, activations, and sales-driving campaigns.

• Provide exemplary day-to-day support to our wholesale partners as their main point of contact with GANNI HQ.

• Support showroom operations in Paris, including OTB discussions/negotiations and collection feedback.

• Stay up to date on the Nordics market trends, competitors, and opportunities and actively share insights internally.

• Coordinate with logistics and internal teams to ensure timely delivery and payment follow-up.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a commercially driven and collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced and international environment.

• 5-7 years of experience in international wholesale within fashion/apparel.

• Strong understanding of the Nordics market dynamics, consumer behavior, and wholesale operations.

• Solid understanding of retail math, including sell-through, mark-up, and OTB planning.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear actions.

• Experience building and maintaining client relationships.

• Experience supporting seasonal sales campaigns and showroom environments.

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with wholesale systems such as JOOR is a plus.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

• Comfortable working across different markets and cultures within the Nordics.

• Flexibility to travel within the region as required.

• Fluent in Danish and English; additional Scandinavian languages are an advantage.

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing Wholesale team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**You will be based at our Copenhagen HQ, while maintaining close and continuous contact with the Paris office and ensuring strong collaboration and alignment with the Denmark team.

We welcome applications from all people regardless of gender identities, sexual orientations, ethnicities, racial identities, religious beliefs, disability statuses and personal expressions. We only want to know why you’re great for this role, so please avoid including your picture, age, and marital status in your CV.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

Where the Business Development team focuses on opening new doors, you focus on going deeper - identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across our already strong client relationships with brands like Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, Vestas, Specsavers, Joe & the Juice, and many more.

In this role, you will work closely alongside our Account Manager and Client Success Managers, reporting to the Director of Sales based in Copenhagen. It is a unique position at the intersection of sales and client relationships - and a powerful stepping stone towards becoming an Account Manager, Account Executive, or Client Success Manager 🚀

You'll get a unique chance to make a tremendous impact - not just on new business, but on the clients who are already trusting us to power their frontline workforce every single day.

**What You'll Be Doing

• Strong desire to understand clients deeply: their business, their challenges, and where Relesys can help them grow

• Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and LinkedIn - you engage stakeholders at multiple levels with confidence and clarity

**What do we offer?

**

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

**As Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner, you will shape how accounting works across Business Area(BA) West. You will spot where processes can be simpler, more standardised and more automated, then work with colleagues in Accounting, Finance and IT to make those changes real. You will be the Accounting expert in the team, providing guidance on complect accounting issues. Across nine affiliates in 11 countries, your work will give colleagues better tools, a smoother user experience and more time for high-quality financial management.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting or a related environment, including accounting, finance transformation, process management or digitalisation.

• A strong understanding of accounting processes and the needs of internal stakeholders.

• Experience driving process improvement, standardisation or digitalisation initiatives.

• Project experience and the ability to work across functions and organisational levels.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to turn business needs into practical improvements.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively.

• Experience in emerging technologies, including how AI and automation can improve finance processes, decision support and ways of working.

**What You’ll Do

**

• You will be the link between central initiatives, accounting expertise and what the business needs day to day. Your focus will be on:

• Finding opportunities to digitalise, automate and simplify accounting processes, and proposing improvements that raise efficiency, quality, compliance and user experience.

• Driving standardisation and alignment of processes, tools and ways of working across Business Area West.

• Supporting the implementation of central initiatives as a strategic partner, and leading projects that draw on your accounting and process expertise.

• Providing process and accounting sparring to colleagues.

• Taking ownership, governance and continuous development of your assigned area.

• Be the link between Accounting Manager, Controller and out Global Shared Service centre in Bangalore

• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation Centre of Excellence for BA West, based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation COE. The team is responsible for accounting and taxation for the nine affiliates and provides expertise, governance and support across accounting, tax, compliance and process excellence.

The team includes Accounting Managers and controllers who work as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates. You and one colleague focus on Business Area West as a whole. Your affiliates cover Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

You will work closely with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business to turn ideas into standardised, efficient ways of working. Challenging the status quo constructively, and speaking up when things are stalling, is part of how this team moves forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with real scope to shape how accounting works across eleven countries. You will build new skills by working across finance, IT and the business, and by exploring how AI and automation can improve finance processes. You will be supported to perform at your best and grow alongside your colleagues.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to be a trusted accounting partner and to make accounting simpler, smarter and more digital across Business Area West, apply for the Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner role by 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you passionate about leading IT compliance in a modern, regulated environment?

Do you combine deep knowledge of GxP, SOX, validation, and emerging regulatory frameworks with the ability to set direction, help people grow, and enable pragmatic delivery?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of IT Compliance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and people-focused Head of IT Compliance to lead our IT Compliance competency team and shape how compliance enables innovation and delivery across Global IT. You will set direction for the area, guide a team of trusted compliance specialists, and partner closely with IT product and platform teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based ways of working.

As Head of IT Compliance at Ascendis Pharma, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You will lead and develop the team while also working alongside them, shaping the direction of the function while actively contributing to its delivery and success.

At Ascendis Pharma, we take a modern approach to IT compliance. Our ambition is to enable continuous compliance through modern IT tools, shift-left testing principles, and agile ways of working. As a leader and senior role model, you will champion critical thinking and a strong quality mindset, challenge unnecessary complexity, and create clarity and confidence for both your team and stakeholders.

You will join Global IT and report directly to Henrik Aagaard Linnemann, Global Head of Digitalization. You will be based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead and further develop the IT Compliance function, including setting direction, developing team capabilities, and fostering a culture of quality, learning, and critical thinking.

• Partner with IT Product and Platform teams operating in GxP-regulated environments to enable compliant, efficient, and business-focused delivery.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and stakeholders on IT compliance, quality management, computer system validation, testing, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Drive the continuous evolution of the IT Quality Management System (IT QMS), governance frameworks, and related compliance processes, including SOX controls.

• Monitor and assess emerging regulatory requirements, ensuring that relevant changes are reflected in IT policies, standards, procedures, and ways of working.

• Promote modern compliance practices by advancing continuous compliance principles, shift-left testing approaches, and agile methodologies across Global IT.

• Build compliance capabilities across the organization through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and awareness initiatives

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree and bring extensive experience from regulated pharmaceutical or life-science environments, ideally including 10+ years within IT compliance, quality, validation, or related disciplines.

You have leadership experience and can combine strategic direction with practical support to teams and stakeholders.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience with GxP, pharmaceutical IT compliance, computer system validation, validation planning, testing, test execution, and quality assurance

• Solid knowledge of SOX controls and regulatory frameworks such as 21 CFR Part 11, EudraLex Volume 4 Annex 11, GAMP 5, the EU AI Act, NIS2, and European data privacy regulations

• A strong technical understanding and the ability to translate complex regulatory expectations into clear, practical guidance for highly skilled IT professionals

• Experience supporting agile product and platform teams while maintaining appropriate regulatory oversight and a risk-based approach

• Experience developing people through leadership, coaching, training, and knowledge sharing, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and geographies

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to be pragmatic, collaborative, and self-driven. You are capable of managing priorities independently, build trusted relationships across stakeholders, and enjoy coaching and developing colleagues through knowledge sharing and guidance.

You possess a strong technical understanding and can communicate effectively with highly skilled IT professionals.

You naturally act as a role model, demonstrating a strong quality mindset, sound judgement, critical thinking, and risk-based decision making. Furthermore, you maintain an up-to-date understanding of evolving regulatory expectations and thrive in environments where continuous improvement, innovation, and practical problem solving are valued.

Travel: Approx. 5-10 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma, Tuborg Havn, Hellerup, Denmark. Global IT is a global function with presence in Denmark, Germany, and the United States, and flexibility is expected when collaborating across time zones.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform. Applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Henrik Aagaard Linnemann, hal@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (15 min) ONSITE

Manager, Skilled Workers – Packaging & Filling Line Maintenance

**Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Are you an experienced leader with a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and a passion for developing skilled technical employees?

Do you thrive in an operational environment where people leadership, equipment reliability and continuous improvement are equally important?

Are you ready to take responsibility for a skilled maintenance team and help strengthen operational performance within HRT Packaging?

If so, we would like to hear from you.

**The Position

**As Manager, Skilled Workers within HRT Packaging, you will lead a team of skilled maintenance employees responsible for supporting the reliability and performance of packaging and filling equipment at our Måløv site.

This is an operational leadership position requiring someone who understands the realities of a production environment and has already demonstrated the ability to lead technical employees.

You will have the opportunity to shape how the team operates, develop the capabilities of experienced technical employees and contribute directly to the department's operational performance.

Working closely with Production and other technical functions, you will balance immediate operational requirements with longer term maintenance improvements, ensuring your team has the direction, structure and support needed to succeed.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing skilled maintenance employees, establishing clear expectations, accountability and continuous development.

• Managing daily maintenance priorities, resources and team performance to support reliable production.

• Ensuring effective preventive and corrective maintenance to improve equipment reliability and minimise downtime.

• Using maintenance data, KPIs and performance trends to identify opportunities and make informed operational decisions.

• Supporting structured problem-solving and addressing recurring equipment issues.

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

• Building effective working relationships with Production, Quality, Engineering and other relevant stakeholders.

• Ensuring maintenance activities comply with GMP, safety and quality requirements.Creating a positive, collaborative and performance focused team culture.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced operational leader who understands both the technical and people-related challenges of managing skilled employees within a manufacturing environment.

**To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

**

• Proven experience leading skilled technical employees within a manufacturing environment, including responsibility for team performance, employee development and day-to-day operational delivery.

• Demonstrable experience managing or formally supervising employees within maintenance, engineering, production or a comparable technical function.

• Practical experience coaching employees, addressing performance challenges and handling difficult leadership situations.

• A sound understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment reliability and manufacturing operations.

• Experience using operational data or performance indicators to support decisions and drive improvements.

• Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP regulated operations, packaging equipment or filling processes would be advantageous.

• We also welcome applications from experienced supervisors and team leaders who have already demonstrated meaningful people leadership and are ready to take on broader management responsibility.

• About YouYou are a confident, visible and approachable leader who enjoys working closely with skilled technical employees.

• You understand that effective leadership requires more than technical knowledge. You can set clear expectations, address performance challenges, coach employees and create an environment where people take ownership of their work.

• You are comfortable making decisions in a busy production environment, using data and operational insights to establish priorities.

• You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can constructively challenge stakeholders when necessary.

• Above all, you bring the maturity, accountability and practical leadership experience needed to develop a team while maintaining operational performance.

**About The Department

**You will join HRT Packaging at our Måløv site, part of Novo's manufacturing organisation.

The department is responsible for packaging hormone replacement therapy products, contributing to the delivery of medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients.

Our maintenance teams play an essential role in ensuring that production equipment operates safely, efficiently and reliably.

With increasing production demands, we are continuing to strengthen our maintenance capabilities, equipment performance and ways of working.

As Manager, Skilled Workers, you will have the opportunity to influence how the team develops and contributes to the department's future success.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, your skills, dedication and ambition help us change lives for the better.

In return, we offer an opportunity to work alongside talented colleagues, take on meaningful responsibilities and continue developing professionally and personally.

Working at NovoAt Novo,

we don't wait for change. We drive it.

We're a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future.

We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them.

From research and development to manufacturing, marketing and sales, we're all working to move the needle on patient care.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is DKK 651,000 to 956,900 annually.

The final salary will depend on the candidate's qualifications, experience and applicable employment conditions.

**Incentives And Benefits

**At Novo, we offer a competitive remuneration package and a range of benefits designed to support our employees' professional and personal wellbeing.

Applicable benefits and incentive arrangements will be discussed as part of the recruitment process.

**What We Offer

**There is nothing ordinary about working at Novo.

Our purpose is to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases, building upon our heritage in diabetes.

We do so by pioneering scientific breakthroughs, expanding access to our medicines and working to prevent and ultimately cure disease.

We offer an inclusive and collaborative working environment where employees can develop their capabilities, contribute their ideas and make a meaningful difference.

**Inclusive Recruitment

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures.

We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities in which we operate.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
